name: EuGenIA
description: My company's product — I'm co-founder of Coyomi Labs. Workflow orchestration for humans and AI: formal state machines coordinate people, tools, and agents, while meta-agents watch for bottlenecks and rebalance the load.

name: Composabase
description: One production-ready GraphQL API composed from the data sources a team already runs — Postgres, MySQL, OpenAPI, Airtable — with auth, caching, and security included.

name: Valgoritmo
description: Company valuations in Spanish, done properly: five-year DCF projections, WACC, and current market data, exported as a documented PDF you can take into a board meeting.

name: A11Y Agent CLI
description: An agentic accessibility auditor in TypeScript. It crawls a site and uses Claude's tool use to run WCAG checks page by page, then writes a report that says what's broken and how to fix it. I care about accessible interfaces enough to build the thing that audits them.
